CONTEXT: Ringer is a Python CLI that runs AI worker swarms and verifies their output by executing check commands. A feature branch adds an OPTIONAL shared evidence store: every worker attempt is always appended to a local JSONL file, and when `[eval] backend = "postgres"` the same attempt is also inserted into a central PostgreSQL table `ringer.attempts`. Key design facts you must judge the code against: (1) local JSONL is the source of truth; (2) each attempt has `attempt_uid` = sha256 of `source_host|logged_at|run_id|task_key|worker_engine` using the exact logged_at string, stamped once and shared by both sinks; (3) inserts use `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` with no conflict target because the writer database role is insert-only and cannot SELECT; (4) `log_sink` is 'postgres' only when the central write succeeded, otherwise 'jsonl' with a `fallback_reason`; (5) prompts are stored centrally as a SHA-256 only by default; (6) `ringer evidence push` validates every row of every selected file before connecting, uses one transaction per file, is idempotent, and never modifies JSONL; (7) the repository is public, so shipped files must contain no environment-specific values or secrets. Background specification: specs/002-shared-evidence/spec.md, plan.md and docs/decisions/002-shared-evidence.md in the repo. The feature work is the diff `git -C /home/powerbox2/src/ringer-worktrees/shared-evidence diff ca3f3b2..HEAD` (new and changed files only; the rest of the repo is unchanged context). Known and accepted: one pre-existing failing test (contributor credits in README) unrelated to this feature; do not report it.

SURFACE AND DIMENSIONS: Your surface: attempt identity, idempotency, transactions and failure handling. Files: ringer_core/central_evidence.py, the EvalLogger class in ringer.py, tests/test_central_evidence.py, tests/test_eval_logger_central.py, tests/test_model_log.py. Dimensions: correctness of attempt_uid (collisions, instability, None/empty fields, unicode, logged_at format variations, hostname drift); whether dual-write can lose or duplicate an attempt; transaction and rollback semantics in push_rows; autocommit versus transaction use; connection lifecycle and what happens after the first failure; thread or async safety (the runner may call log_attempt from several tasks at once, so reason about shared state such as the connection and the warn-once flag); ordering of the central insert and the JSONL append and what each failure mode leaves behind; whether log_sink and fallback_reason are always truthful; spec policy edge cases (redaction marker, empty spec).

HOW TO RUN: from your task directory use absolute paths under /home/powerbox2/src/ringer-worktrees/shared-evidence. Optional read-only verification: git -C /home/powerbox2/src/ringer-worktrees/shared-evidence diff --stat ca3f3b2..HEAD.

Each finding must use exactly this shape: '### Finding: <neutral summary>', then lines starting 'Evidence:', 'Impact:', 'Fix:', 'Priority: P0|P1|P2|P3' and 'Confidence: high|medium|low'. Evidence must cite repo-relative `file:line` (for example `ringer_core/central_evidence.py:27`) and quote at most a short phrase in backticks that appears verbatim in the cited file; an automated check verifies that every cited file and line exists and that every backticked quotation of 20+ characters appears in the cited file, and fails the report otherwise.
